Healthcare SEO & Digital Marketing

Reach More Patients, Save More Lives

A practice can deliver excellent care and still struggle to grow if patients can't find it online. Most people now search for a doctor the same way they search for a restaurant: a quick search, a scan of reviews, a look at the website, and a decision made in minutes. If a practice's website doesn't rank, its Google Business Profile is unclaimed, or its reviews go unanswered, that decision goes to a competitor instead.

Healthcare digital marketing is different from marketing any other business, because it has to work within HIPAA and advertising rules specific to medicine, and because trust matters more here than in almost any other buying decision a person makes. A generic marketing agency that doesn't understand those constraints can create real compliance risk.

PMEX manages the entire digital marketing operation for a healthcare practice, from planning to execution to optimization, covering website SEO, local search, online advertising and content, all built HIPAA-compliant from the ground up.

Compliance & Data Security

Marketing That Respects Patient Privacy

Digital marketing for a medical practice follows the same HIPAA rules and regulations that govern the rest of your operation. Encryption, authentication and backup systems protect data at every step, and campaigns are built to respect and protect patient privacy and security, not just clicks and conversions.

Because PMEX also manages medical billing, coding and credentialing, your marketing runs alongside those services under the same compliance standards, instead of as a separate vendor with no visibility into healthcare-specific rules.
